attractions.name: Athirappilly Waterfalls
attractions.description: Known as the 'Niagara of Kerala,' this is the largest waterfall in Kerala standing at 80 feet, cascading dramatically through dense greenery on the Chalakudy River at the entrance to the Sholayar ranges.
